pr_body:
Proposed change
Fix the ephember component.
Bump the version of pyephember from 0.3.1 to 0.4.0 + update ephember/climate.py to use the new APIs.
https://github.com/ttroy50/pyephember/blob/master/API.md

I have fixed up the boost (aux), set_temperature and set_mode functions.
I had to remove the Hot Water zone detection from the old methods as I couldn't figure out how that works.I think it is device_type, Basically if it is a hot water zone the temperature set isn't supposed to be set. I set the max and min temp range to be same as the EPH Ember app.
